general_lessons: Model-tier divergence has a structure: Haiku vs Sonnet cricket pairs diverge only on severity grading, never on redirection direction; Sonnet vs Opus diverge on stance/frame-acceptance. Direction < severity < frame-judgement is the observed cost/value ordering for adding a higher tier.

A fleet's frame-challenger role must be reserved for the highest tier and made mandate-only (not optional) — Sonnet fleets given a frame that is wrong will classify faithfully within it rather than reject it; only Opus seats in the 14-agent instance rejected the handed frame.

Reviewer/subagent liveness is not delivery: SendMessage/notification queues 'for the next tool round' and a wedged agent has no next round, so queued-success reads are indistinguishable from a dead dispatch without a direct transcript-mtime or symlink-aware stat check.

Cellular/overlapping-region sweeps (offset-stride Haiku regions) generate a disagreement field usable as a cheap salience map before a more expensive single-coverage pass — roughly half the cost for the first landscape layer in the one instantiated case.

Large-scale reduce/map fleet stages have a proven precedent ceiling (581 leaves in this estate); scaling a single reducer call past that precedent without sharding produced repeated thinking-only turns that silently burned output budget with no emitted result — the cure was sharding under the proven scale plus a turn-shape (not just file-growth) liveness check.

Sampling-based automated reviewers (e.g. Copilot on a dense multi-file diff) have no fixed point across rounds; convergence requires an explicit class-kill move (one assertExactSet-style sweep) rather than continued per-instance rounds, plus an operator materiality/tally-stop ruling to bound the loop.

Standing goal-hooks that impose completion drive remove the peer-brake effect that n>=2 team shapes otherwise provide; the estate's cure was reverting a goal-hook to an n=2 pair with a shared ARC channel rather than continuing solo.

A first-pass author's own topology/taxonomy model is the least-reviewed artifact in the estate — quorum/panel review pays off most exactly where the author feels most confident, per the PDR-101 four-seat review of PDR-133.

encoding_mechanisms.mechanism: Practice Decision Records (PDR) with Status/Falsifiability/Worked-instances/Amendment sections
encoding_mechanisms.assessment: Highly discoverable and durable: each PDR carries a related-PDR cross-reference graph, an explicit falsifiability section with named second-instance evidence paths, and dated amendment sections that accrete new worked-instance-derived clauses in place rather than forking a new document — a legible, append-only history of how each fleet-topology doctrine actually evolved under use.

encoding_mechanisms.mechanism: Named pattern files in .agent/memory/active/patterns/ with polarity/proven_in/proven_date/barrier front matter
encoding_mechanisms.assessment: Usable as a checked-in, greppable library: each file states a single reusable shape with an explicit proven_in worked instance, a proven_date, and a barrier block (broadly_applicable/proven_by_implementation/prevents_recurring_mistake/stable) that functions as a graduation gate — cheap for an agent to scan use_this_when and decide relevance before reading the body.

encoding_mechanisms.mechanism: PDR-130 two-speed learning register (fast lane vs slow lane) with mandatory prediction+falsifier per graduation
encoding_mechanisms.assessment: A meta-mechanism governing how ALL the other encoding mechanisms (rules, skills, validators, PDRs) get minted: every graduation must carry a one-sentence expected-effect-and-falsifier, and constitutional-class concepts route through a dated quarterly-reviewed slow-lane register rather than same-day promotion.

encoding_mechanisms.mechanism: PDR-134 knowledge-strata/carrier contract (ontology/practice/repo/operator strata; prose/front-matter/concept-scheme carriers)
encoding_mechanisms.assessment: A stack-neutral portability contract, not itself a topology record, but decides WHERE fleet-topology knowledge like PDR-117/PDR-082 is allowed to live and how cross-instance concept sharing must work; usable mainly by a host's own architectural decision records.

encoding_mechanisms.where_seen: .agent/practice-core/decision-records/PDR-117-director-and-implementer-roles.md and .agent/practice-core/decision-records/PDR-082-n2-collaboration-mode.md, e.g. 'the SKILL becomes the operational entry point; this PDR is the doctrine source'
encoding_mechanisms.assessment: Named but not read in this pass (out of scope); PDRs describe it as the operational carrier at team-start with the PDR as doctrine source — a two-layer encoding (skill=mechanism, PDR=rationale/evidence) for both topologies covered here.

general_lessons: Multi-agent shape choice tracks reversibility and scale, not preference: verification/refutation work fans out (independent lenses catch what a single author's re-diff misses), while irreversible execution (delete, commit, merge, launch) stays serial and first-hand under one accountable gatekeeper.

Coordination protocol overhead is non-linear in team size; substrate justified at n>=4 becomes pure overhead at n=2, and the estate's response was a named, falsifiable, exit-triggered MODE rather than a silent convention, to keep the reduction auditable.

Every fleet/topology doctrine graduated here carries an explicit falsifier and named second-instance evidence path (PDR-026/PDR-130 discipline) rather than being asserted as settled on first observation — multiple PDRs are still 'Proposed' or scoped as 'first-instance' pending replication.

Structured-output fan-outs fail predictably at specific mechanical points (unbounded arrays, unparsed args, mid-run verifier death, deeply-nested schemas) and the estate's cure is architectural (bound by construction, guard parsing, treat verify results as sparse) rather than prompting harder.

A verification/triage round is only half-checked if only the confirmed/surviving claims are re-verified; the rejected/downgraded half carries equal risk and is the more dangerous blind spot because a wrongly-dropped finding never resurfaces on its own.
